notes.title: NextFest Wrap-up
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45244425/b9176f73c349bf00a1a80c61933e5b946f5d9ead.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45244425/e2a4b6baad1f7da83b038ef30a64beca92e48341.png[/img][/url]
[h2]What's next?[/h2]

I'm looking to secure funding to produce this game full time. Know someone? Shoot me a [url=https://bsky.app/profile/milanks.com]message[/url] 
With support I can see this game releasing early 2026. My production to do's include:

[list]
[*]2-3 hours of main story content 
[*]Several free-play "challenge" loops 
[*]Level editor with Steam Workshop integration and without jank!
[*]A world populated with hand drawn homunculi and critters
[*]Harmony! Melody! Hire someone that knows music theory
[*]New synths, unique timbres, sound pushed to its limits
[*]Steam Deck support
[*]Localization!!!
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45244425/4c8a97e53e1d7d4fac6d1f0268ecf567746b3f39.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45244425/fd9bdfe0049c98008cfe090c620affe901b94c0e.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Don't be a stranger![/h2]

It's been exciting to have Stellations out in the wild and know what's working, what's not, and to see enthusiasm for more. The demo will stay up for another couple weeks. If you haven't given the level editor a go, I'd love to see what you make in [url=https://discord.gg/2PV4twBEue]discord[/url]!

I'll leave you with some drawings I added last week.
I look forward to sharing more!
